findings.label: TaskCard undefined deadline label
findings.description: If formatRelativeDeadline(task.deadline) returns null, accessing deadline.label throws an error. TaskCard does guard with {deadline && ...} which prevents the crash, but the formatter returns null for falsy deadlines.

findings.label: Relative deadline format mismatch
findings.description: formatRelativeDeadline() returns an object {label, color} but consumers only use .label. The color field is unused. Also, deadlineBadgeClass() duplicates the date parsing logic.

findings.label: Focus feedback scoping issue
findings.description: The Dashboard passes onFocusStart handler to TaskCard components in the priority queue, but TaskCard never calls it. There's no focus button on individual queue cards, making the handler dead code.

findings.label: Analytics parameter not passed
findings.description: The Dashboard calls analyticsApi.get() with no arguments, but the API method accepts optional userId. If user context is available, it should be passed for user-specific analytics.

findings.label: Stats Today calculation fallback unreliable
findings.description: When prioritizedTasks count is 0, Dashboard falls back to analytics data which may be stale or use a different time window. Remove the fallback and always use the computed value.

findings.label: Sort by Priority not implemented
findings.description: The UI shows a 'Priority' sort button, but the useMemo sort logic doesn't handle sortBy === 'priority'. It falls through to default (recommended order). Add a case that sorts by priority_score DESC.

findings.label: Focus error message persistence
findings.description: When focus session fails, the error message persists until the next interaction. Consider clearing it when the user clicks Start Focus again, or auto-dismiss after timeout.
